description: The plot illustrates the relationship between Average Lagging (AL) and BLEU score for four different models. The x-axis is labeled "Average Lagging (AL)" with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 6, and tick labels at intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled "BLEU" with a linear scale, ranging from 12 to 28, and tick labels at intervals of 2. The plot displays four lines representing different models: Consistency-CE (purple dashed line with circle markers), Inconsistency-CE (dark purple dashed line with square markers), and Inconsistency-CE-MP (blue dashed line with square markers), and an unspecified model (red solid line with star markers). The Consistency-CE line starts at a BLEU score of approximately 13 at AL = 0 and increases to around 26.5 at AL = 6.5. The Inconsistency-CE line begins at a BLEU score of about 20 at AL = 0.5 and rises to approximately 27 at AL = 6.5. The Inconsistency-CE-MP line commences at a BLEU score of around 20.5 at AL = 0.5 and reaches about 27 at AL = 6.5. The red line starts at a BLEU score of roughly 23 at AL = 0 and increases to approximately 27.5 at AL = 7. All lines exhibit an overall increasing trend as AL increases.
